explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1158: ex_t(n, K_t(r)) ≥ n^{t - r^{1-t} - o(1)}, encoded as 'for each ε > 0, eventually ≥ n^{t - r^{1-t} - ε}', for t, r ≥ 2. partiteExtremalNumber is the maximum size of a t-uniform family on Fin n containing no embedded complete t-partite hypergraph with parts of size r, which is correct. Excluding r = 1 is necessary: K_t(1) is a single edge, so ex = 0, and the page's 'all t, r' would be literally false there.
